beats: [d:intrigue][sfx:boom][act:hushed wonder, drawing them in]There's a space inside the Great Pyramid of Egypt that ^*nobody* has ever entered. [act:lighter, a teaser][tune:level]No ^door. [act:same, playful][tune:level]No ^tunnel. [act:quiet][tune:fall]Not a single ^photo.
[d:tension][act:confiding, slowing down]We only ^know it's there... [act:the reveal, quietly delighted]because of tiny particles falling from ^*space*.

[d:calm][act:setting the scene, plain]This is the Great Pyramid at Giza, credited to the pharaoh ^Khufu, at least four and a half thousand years ago. [p:0.93][act:giving the size, admiring]A mountain of stone, a hundred and forty-six metres ^tall when it was built. [go:2|2.2][act:guiding the eye, unhurried]Inside, three great rooms: the ^King's Chamber, the ^Queen's, and the long, sloping Grand ^Gallery.

[d:build][go:3|2][act:explaining, a spark of wonder]Now, the trick. [act:explaining, clear]When cosmic rays from space hit our air, they make [sfx:shimmer]^muons, heavy cousins of the ^electron. [act:lighter, marvelling]They rain down on us all the time, and pass through almost ^*everything*. [act:playful, an aside]A few are going through your hand right ^now.

[d:build][p:0.93][act:patient, the analogy]It works like an ^X-ray. [act:patient, laying it out][tune:level]^Thick stone stops some muons. [act:the payoff, clear and simple][tune:fall]^Empty space lets more of them ^*through*. [p:0.93][act:explaining, step by step]So put detectors below the stone, count the muons from every direction, and a ^hollow shows up as a bright ^spot.

[d:build][go:4|2][act:brisk, matter of fact]Three teams set up three different kinds of detector, ^inside the pyramid, and ^out. [p:0.93][act:the method, careful]Different tools, one question: if they all ^agree, it isn't a glitch in one ^machine.
[d:reveal][go:5|2.2][sfx:hit][act:the discovery, measured]All three saw ^extra muons, coming from the same place: ^above the Grand Gallery.

[d:wonder][stamp:NATURE · 2017|gold][act:wonder, slowly]An ^empty space, announced in {2017|twenty seventeen}. [p:0.9][act:letting the size land]At least ^*thirty* metres long: about three ^buses, end to end.

[d:reveal][act:leaning in, fresh news]Then came a ^test. [act:explaining, clear]In {2023|twenty twenty-three}, muons found a ^second, smaller corridor, about nine metres long, just behind the north ^face.

[d:build][go:7|0][act:quiet, careful, step by step]This one, a ^camera could reach. [act:quiet, careful]It slid in through a gap between the ^stones. [sfx:shimmer][gap:0.4][act:hushed, the reveal][tune:fall]^*Empty*, under a gabled roof. [act:quiet satisfaction][tune:fall]^Right where the muons said.

[d:verdict][p:0.95][act:calm, weighing it up]So the method ^works: it called the corridor, and the camera ^agreed. [act:turning to the big one][tune:rise]And the Big ^Void? [act:the verdict, level-headed][tune:fall]^*Strong* evidence it's there. [act:fair, the limit]Three teams saw it, but nobody yet knows its exact ^shape.
[d:tension][p:0.93][act:quieter, the open mystery]What it was ^*for*... [act:simple, honest]^nobody knows. [gap:0.4][act:a small hopeful smile][tune:fallrise]^Yet.
